The '''Executives''' were the board of directors that oversaw the [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. The board consisted of six members, each of which was responsible for one of LMC's six divisions; [[Mining (department)|Mining]], [[Refining]], [[Resource Discovery]], [[Research and Design]], [[Sales]], and [[Security Patrol]].
